summary: End GitHub watches silently for retired recipients and isolate watch maintenance failures

replay.detail: No replay changes. Watch maintenance uses existing terminal recipient admission to end a retired recipient's watch without sending a deadline wake.

schema.detail: No schema, generated client, or store version changes. Retired recipients use the existing seat-ended reason.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing watch declarations and ended records remain compatible. Item faults remain visible while other watches and observer cleanup continue.

downtime.detail: No expected interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state migration or new rollback restrictions.
